reason: A dsh profile bundle that bridges OneBot 11 QQ chats to dsh agents through a forward WebSocket connection, with per-chat sessions, message tools, and controlled outbound replies.

summaries.zh: 通过正向 WebSocket 将 OneBot 11 的 QQ 私聊和群聊接入 dsh 智能体，并提供会话持久化与消息处理工具。
summaries.en: Connects OneBot 11 QQ private and group chats to dsh agents over a forward WebSocket, with persistent per-chat sessions and message tools.

capabilities: Connects to a OneBot 11 service over WebSocket
Receives QQ private and group messages
Sends agent replies and other messages to QQ
Persists per-chat sessions as JSONL and creates per-chat workspaces
Provides message history, content retrieval, status, and voice-to-text tools
Supports in-chat approval for non-whitelisted outbound messages
